name: browser-static-assets
description: Add a typed native browser-module build and a Cloudflare Workers static-assets path.

optionalSteps.name: progressive-interaction
optionalSteps.when: The target has a conventional server form that should gain background submission and fragment replacement.
optionalSteps.prompt: Do you want to apply the separate progressive-interaction kit and install it from the browser entrypoint?

docs: Document public/assets as generated output and public/_headers as authored deployment configuration.
Document that Worker-generated HTML owns its own CSP and security headers.
Document the server-rendered no-JavaScript path for every installed browser behavior.
notes: Native module scripts are deferred by default and require explicit .js suffixes for relative emitted imports.
Stable, unhashed module names use revalidation rather than immutable caching.
Worker application routes run first while /assets/* uses the static-assets path.
